command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export PLUMED_KERNEL=/opt/conda/lib/libplumedKernel.so
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C GMX_MAXBACKUP=-1
cd /tmp
echo "== GROMACS integrates 23k atoms with PLUMED coupled live every step =="
# spc216 + amber99sb-ildn/tip3p ship in the gromacs package, so a real system needs zero
# staging: solvate a 6.2 nm box from the 216-water template.
GRO=/opt/conda/share/gromacs/top/spc216.gro
printf '#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/forcefield.itp"\n#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/tip3p.itp"\n[ system ]\nwater\n[ molecules ]\n' > topol.top
gmx_mpi solvate -cs "$GRO" -box 6.2 6.2 6.2 -o big.gro -p topol.top > solvate.log 2>&1
NWAT=$(awk '/^SOL/{print $2; exit}' topol.top); NATOM=$(awk -v n="$NWAT" 'BEGIN{print n*3}')
echo "solvated $NWAT waters = $NATOM atoms"

# Minimise before dynamics: solvate packs overlapping waters and dynamics from those collapse.
printf 'integrator = steep\nnsteps = 2000\nemtol = 100\ncutoff-scheme = Verlet\ncoulombtype = PME\nrvdw = 0.9\nrcoulomb = 0.9\n' > em.mdp
gmx_mpi grompp -f em.mdp -c big.gro -p topol.top -o em.tpr -maxwarn 5 > grompp_em.log 2>&1
gmx_mpi mdrun -s em.tpr -deffnm em -ntomp 8 -pin on > mdrun_em.log 2>&1

printf 'integrator = md\nnsteps = 50000\ndt = 0.002\ncutoff-scheme = Verlet\ncoulombtype = PME\nrvdw = 0.9\nrcoulomb = 0.9\nconstraints = h-bonds\ntcoupl = v-rescale\ntc-grps = System\ntau-t = 0.1\nref-t = 300\ngen-vel = yes\ngen-temp = 300\ngen-seed = 42\n' > md.mdp

# PLUMED, 1-based atom indices. Water 1 is atoms 1,2,3 = OW,HW1,HW2.
#   d / a  -- geometry of a rigid water: these are FORCE-FIELD CONSTANTS, so they are the
#             exact checks below, with no tolerance to argue about.
#   c      -- coordination of 5 oxygens against every oxygen: a real physical observable from
#             the real simulation, reported not asserted (PLUMED's default switching function
#             is soft, so this is NOT the hard-count first-shell number).
OX=$(awk -v n="$NWAT" 'BEGIN{for(i=0;i<n;i++) printf "%s%d", (i?",":""), i*3+1}')
{ printf 'd: DISTANCE ATOMS=1,2\na: ANGLE ATOMS=2,1,3\n'
  printf 'c: COORDINATION GROUPA=1,4,7,10,13 GROUPB=%s R_0=0.35\n' "$OX"
  printf 'PRINT ARG=d,a,c FILE=COLVAR STRIDE=100\n'; } > plumed.dat

gmx_mpi grompp -f md.mdp -c em.gro -p topol.top -o t.tpr -maxwarn 5 > grompp.log 2>&1
T0=$(date +%s)
gmx_mpi mdrun -s t.tpr -deffnm out -plumed plumed.dat -ntomp 8 -pin on > mdrun.log 2>&1
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
tail -2 mdrun.log || true

python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys, numpy as np
rows = [l.split() for l in open("COLVAR") if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")]
t = np.array([float(r[0]) for r in rows])
d = np.array([float(r[1]) for r in rows])
a = np.array([float(r[2]) for r in rows])
c = np.array([float(r[3]) for r in rows])
mdrun = open("mdrun.log").read()
fail = []
def check(l, ok, detail):
    print(f"{l:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)

# The coupling actually ran: GROMACS finished AND PLUMED wrote CVs.
check("gromacs_plumed_ran", "Performance:" in mdrun and len(d) > 0,
      f"{len(d)} COLVAR rows, mdrun {'finished' if 'Performance:' in mdrun else 'DID NOT FINISH'}")
check("colvar_rows", len(d) == 501, f"{len(d)}  want 501 (50000/100 + t=0)")

# EXACT: a rigid TIP3P water's geometry is a force-field constant, not a sampled quantity.
# constraints = h-bonds holds O-H at 0.09572 nm and the angle at 104.52 deg = 1.82422 rad,
# so PLUMED reading anything else means the coupling or the CV is wrong -- there is no
# tolerance to pick, only the force field's own numbers.
check("distance_cv", abs(d.mean() - 0.09572) < 1e-4,
      f"{d.mean():.5f} nm  want 0.09572 (TIP3P O-H, via PLUMED DISTANCE)")
check("angle_cv", abs(a.mean() - 1.82422) < 2e-3,
      f"{a.mean():.5f} rad  want 1.82422 (104.52 deg, via PLUMED ANGLE)")
check("distance_invariant", (d.max() - d.min()) < 1e-4,
      f"spread {d.max()-d.min():.2e} nm  want < 1e-4 (rigid water, 501 frames)")
check("angle_invariant", (a.max() - a.min()) < 1e-3,
      f"spread {a.max()-a.min():.2e} rad  want < 1e-3 (rigid water, 501 frames)")

# Observation, correctly labelled. PLUMED's COORDINATION with GROUPA/GROUPB sums over ALL
# PAIRS, so with 5 central oxygens the CV is a TOTAL, not a mean -- an earlier version printed
# it as "per O" and read 40.686, which is nine times a first-shell count and was a labelling
# error, not a wrong number. Divided by the 5 central atoms it is ~8.1, still above the
# hard-count ~4.5 because the default RATIONAL switch (NN=6, MM=12) decays slowly and
# partially counts second-shell neighbours past the nominal R_0. Not asserted against any
# literature value for exactly that reason.
NA = 5
print(f"coordination_total         {c.mean():.3f}  (sum over {NA} central O x all O pairs)")
print(f"coordination_per_atom      {c.mean()/NA:.3f}  within R_0=0.35 nm, SOFT switch")
print(f"coordination_per_atom_range {c.min()/NA:.3f}..{c.max()/NA:.3f}")
print(f"sim_time_ps                {t[-1]:.1f}")
if fail:
    print("FAILED: " + ", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PYEOF
echo "atoms              $NATOM" >> smoke-check.txt
echo "wall_s             $WALL" >> smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
